meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Team-first maximum-saturation research orchestration for omo-senpi. Scopes solo, ALWAYS asks which final format to render (PDF+DOCX default), then stands up a max-size cooperating team (team_create): one member per axis plus skeptic/red-team members for ultradebate/hyperdebate cross-critique, explore/librarian lanes, live ulw-loop journaling, an EXPAND loop until leads run dry, claims proven by code or the claim-graph gate, and a cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid/assets behind visual-QA and `writing` proofread gates. ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user demand for research: the word 'ulw-research' ('/ulw-research', '$ulw-research'), any 'ulw' research wording, 'ultradebate' or 'hyperdebate' research requests, or an explicit request for research / deep research / an ultra-precise investigation, in any language. Never self-activates for ordinary questions, debugging, or implementation context-gathering. While active it overrides exploration-bounding defaults: exhaustive coverage is the goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组建多智能体辩论团队，穷尽式深挖问题并产出带引用的综合报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果遇到难以定论的复杂课题时，希望自动启动一支多角色研究团队穷尽论证
copy.tagline_en: Orchestrate multi-agent deep research and deliver a cited synthesis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a thorough, multi-angle investigation on a hard question without managing many sub-agents yourself.

howto.what: 接到明确研究请求后,Claude先自行拆解问题并询问最终交付格式(默认PDF+DOCX),再组建最大团队(每分析轴一人,加质疑者),分头检索、穷追线索、交叉辩论,用代码验证争议结论,最后产出带引用的综合报告并经过视觉质检与校对。
howto.when: 仅在你明确要求研究时触发,例如说“ulw-research”、“ultradebate/hyperdebate”或“深度研究”等;普通提问、调试、收集上下文不会自动启用。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 研究一下 Rust 异步运行时的最新对比。
say.note: 进入该模式,先确认交付格式,再组队分头检索。

say.text: hyperdebate 研究:固态电池量产还有哪些未解难题?
say.note: 会安排质疑/红队成员交叉辩论并验证结论。

say.text: 我要一份深度研究报告,最终输出 PDF 加 DOCX。
say.note: 组队前会先和你确认格式与模板。

howto.what_en: On explicit research request, Claude scopes the topic, asks output format, builds a full team with skeptics, explores exhaustively, debates, verifies contested claims by code, and delivers a cited synthesis after visual QA and proofreading.
howto.when_en: Activates only on an explicit research demand: 'ulw-research', an 'ultradebate/hyperdebate' request, or a request for deep research. Not for ordinary questions, debugging, or context-gathering.

say_en.text: Use ulw-research to compare the latest Rust async runtime options.
say_en.note: Activates mode, asks format, then assembles team.

say_en.text: Hyperdebate: open problems in solid-state battery mass production?
say_en.note: Sets up skeptic/red-team members to cross-examine findings.

say_en.text: I want a deep research report, final output as PDF plus DOCX.
say_en.note: Before forming the team, it asks for format and template.
